Fire Protection Butterfly Valve

Lever-Operated Grooved Butterfly Valve

A manual lever-operated butterfly valve with grooved ends for quick installation on grooved fire protection piping. A visible lever with a position-locking plate provides simple open/close control.

DN50–DN2002–8 inGroovedPN16 / 1.6 MPaLever operated
